Subject: Your land dispute matter

Dear Mr. Rajan,

Thank you for meeting us on 26 August 2026 about your dispute with Varun Srivastava. As we understand it, the neighbour has encroached on the boundary of the plot. The matter is listed before the Pune District Court.

Our advice is to apply for a court commissioner to measure the boundary. Please collect the sale deed, the survey map and the land records and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹1.7 crore.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
